subject: [PATCH v4 17/21] fuse: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations for the FUSE file system to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using macros that wrap the iomap_iter_next() helper. This change does not introduce any functional changes and only updates the implementation of the iomap operations. The conversion affects three files: fs/fuse/dax.c, fs/fuse/file.c, and fs/fuse/virtio_fs.c.
